description: Correlated privilege escalation, sensitive-target, and denial or elevated-context evidence requires analyst review.
recommended_action: Review privilege audit records and the requested target; verify authorization before taking action.

description: Observed 5 distinct failed authentication attempt(s) from one source in the configured time window.
recommended_action: Review the source and authentication evidence; apply access controls only after confirming the activity.

description: A successful authentication followed repeated recent failure attempts for the same account and source.
recommended_action: Review the account and preceding failures promptly; verify the successful login with the account owner.
